```artifact
Feature: Battery Management System

  Scenario: GUI can compute battery ETA from a history of remaining battery amounts
    Given a battery history list of [100, 90, 80]
    When the GUI computes the battery ETA
    Then the battery ETA should be 30 minutes

  Scenario: GUI is connected to a battery amount sensor
    Given the battery sensor is connected
    When the GUI reads the battery amount
    Then the battery amount should be within the expected range

  Scenario: GUI can compute a "low battery" alarm when battery ETA is <30min
    Given a battery history list of [100, 50, 20]
    When the GUI computes the battery ETA
    Then a "low battery" alarm should be triggered
    And the alarm priority should be low

  Scenario: GUI can compute a "critically low battery" alarm when battery ETA is <10min
    Given a battery history list of [100, 10, 0]
    When the GUI computes the battery ETA
    Then a "critically low battery" alarm should be triggered
    And the alarm priority should be high

  Scenario: GUI needs to have a "battery failure" alarm that is activated when the battery is absent, unavailable, or unchargeable
    Given the battery is absent
    When the GUI checks the battery status
    Then a "battery failure" alarm should be triggered

  Scenario Outline: Boundary value tests for ETA thresholds
    Given a battery history list of <battery_history>
    When the GUI computes the battery ETA
    Then the battery ETA should be <expected_eta>

    Examples:
      | battery_history | expected_eta |
      | [100, 50, 10]   | 9            |
      | [100, 50, 5]    | 8            |
      | [100, 50, 100] | 0            |
```
